zh-CN: 本地同版本维护：图片预览有限并发，视频部分失败保留成功帧，增加预览预算与实际进度；入库避免全库深拷贝和无变化索引重建。
修复部分多显示适配器 Windows 环境中纯 AI/MCP 启动失败的问题，恢复 Electron 默认图形选择。
AI 快速上手、MCP 说明和能力清单改为单语精简入口，具体能力通过运行时按需发现。
不更改仓库格式、用户资料位置或现有记录，无需迁移。
en-US: Local same-version maintenance: bounded image concurrency, retained successful video frames, preview budgets and progress; intake avoids full-manifest cloning and unchanged index rebuilds.
Fixes AI/MCP startup on affected multi-display-adapter Windows systems by restoring Electron's default graphics selection.
Replaces duplicated bilingual AI guidance and the embedded capability catalog with concise single-language entry points and runtime discovery.
Warehouse format, user-data locations, and existing records are unchanged; no migration is required.
